answer: Sybil resistance via non-transferable duty stamps. Each identity earns one stamp by passing a small verifiable task, e.g. validating a random batch. Stamps bind to the identity, expire in 24h, and cannot be sold or pooled. Jobs are sampled at random, like a raven picking stones, so no one knows which task yields a stamp; work must finish before the zenith deadline or the stamp decays, and any delta of failed checks voids it. Each puppet must run real computation per stamp, no bulk discount, so N fakes cost N times the honest price.
